authorization: User resumed the plan and authorized autonomous local work, commits and pushes, stopping at a material user judgment.
scope: Saved-record WP1 input/reference readiness audit only; no model results, decoder or production execution.
reuse: Reuse candidates.inventory and its complete saved roster. Do not rerun the closed S1/distribution/mean operations.

readiness.episode_exclusion: NOT_FROZEN; three prior regional exemplars share sample4; no independent holdout claim
readiness.resource_budgets: Existing 3000000000-byte total cap retained; scoring CPU/RSS limits await an executable geometry/reference definition
readiness.first_unmet_condition: Native contour/strip support and reference role precision have not been jointly bound. Existing candidate/scalar/regional approvals are not dense contour labels.

interpretation.authority: Agent interpretation of the cited owners, separate from machine-verified bindings and the original human replies.
interpretation.existing_useful_evidence: Seven sample4 candidate identities, three wrong-target controls, regional Oil/structure/texture contexts and qualified single-column position intervals remain usable at their actual precision.
interpretation.no_blanket_annotation_requirement: This does not require whole-video labeling or pixel-exact truth for qualitative research. It identifies a missing declared relationship between the proposed contour strips and the available reviews.
interpretation.choice_needed: Either explicitly limit CR-1 to candidate-centred regional-context preference (no observed-contour role claim), or review a small native-support reference set before freezing the contour-strip experiment.
interpretation.no_silent_substitution: Do not snap an approved scalar to a nearby edge, fill a reviewed interval, label all paths in that range, extrapolate a one-column reply across X, or count a reference self-match as a positive screen.
interpretation.not_claimed: No assertion that DINOv2 fails, that no useful future bank can exist, or that every existing regional reference is invalid.

stop: Before WP1 scored-operation freeze, installation, download or inference when the support/scope choice needs user judgment.
